scope: Post-hoc exposed-data diagnostic only; all four v13 datasets; not causal proof and not a new predictor.

method.projection_basis: the fixed v13 GROUP U common to every stored method
method.energy: mean complete-target-vector Euclidean squared error divided by C
method.subset: target finite mask.all(axis=-1), identical across methods in each dataset/period
method.diagnostic_question: whether remaining loss plausibly concentrates in group-space main P or orthogonal Q

test_a.mask_rule: finite target mask.all(axis=-1); shared by every method in this dataset/period

test_b.mask_rule: finite target mask.all(axis=-1); shared by every method in this dataset/period

combined.mask_rule: finite target mask.all(axis=-1); shared by every method in this dataset/period
